function cards(){const mn=+PMIN||0,mx=+PMAX||1e9;let r=IT.map((x,i)=>[x,i]).filter(([x])=>(G<0||x.g==G)&&(!Q||(x.n+' '+GR[x.g]).toLowerCase().includes(Q))&&x.b>=mn&&x.b<=mx&&(!WLF||wish.includes(x.n))&&(QF!='pop'||x.f.includes('p'))&&(QF!='new'||x.f.includes('n'))&&(QF!='u1k'||x.b<1000)&&(QF!='xmas'||x.f.includes('x')));
if(SO==1)r.sort((a,b)=>a[0].b-b[0].b);else if(SO==2)r.sort((a,b)=>b[0].b-a[0].b);else if(SO==3)r.sort((a,b)=>a[0].n.localeCompare(b[0].n));
const rc=$('#rc');if(rc)rc.textContent=r.length+' of '+IT.length+' products';
return r.map(([x,i])=>card(x,i,1)).join('')||'<p class="hint">Nothing matches. Try different filters, or ask for a quote.</p>'}

track:()=>{const o=co(),ql=quotes.length?`<h2>Your quote requests</h2>${quotes.map((q,qi)=>`<div class="row"><div class="grow"><b>${q.id}: ${esc(q.n)}</b><small>${q.qty?'Quantity '+esc(q.qty)+'. ':''}${q.files.length?q.files.length+' file'+(q.files.length>1?'s':'')+'. ':''}${q.online?'Online design attached.':''}</small><div class="bar" style="margin:6px 0"><i style="width:${((q.st||0)+1)/3*100}%"></i></div><small>${['Request received','We are reviewing your design','Quote sent. Check your phone or email.'][q.st||0]}</small>${(q.st||0)<2?`<button class="lnk" style="margin-top:4px" onclick="qa(${qi})">Staff view: next step</button>`:''}</div></div>`).join('')}`:'';
const look=`<div class="apply" style="max-width:460px;margin-bottom:18px"><input id="foin" placeholder="KZ-1234" aria-label="Order number"><button class="btn" onclick="findo()">Find order</button></div>`;
if(!o)return`<div class="wrap"><h1>Track order</h1>${look}<div class="empty"><div class="eico">${ic('pin2')}</div><h2 style="margin:0 0 8px">No orders yet</h2><p>Submit a design for a quote, or design online and order straight away.</p><a class="btn" href="#shop">Browse products</a></div>${ql}</div>`;
const fin=o.st==5,ts=o.ts||[o.at];return`<div class="wrap"><h1>Track order</h1>${look}<div class="chips" style="margin-bottom:16px">${orders.map(x=>`<button class="chip${x.id==o.id?' on':''}" onclick="cur='${x.id}';view()">${x.id}</button>`).join('')}<span class="chip" style="cursor:default">${PTS} points</span></div>
${o.sent?'':`<div class="alt" style="margin-bottom:14px"><b>One last step.</b> Send your order to our team on WhatsApp so we can start right away.<a class="btn full" target="_blank" rel="noopener" onclick="markSent('${o.id}')" href="${wa(orderMsg(o))}">Send order ${o.id} on WhatsApp</a></div>`}<div class="ticket"><div class="sum"><h2 style="margin:0">Order ${o.id}</h2><b>${K(o.total)}</b></div><small>${DL[o.d][1]?'Delivery to '+esc(o.addr):'Pick up from Kazisafi'}. ${TA[o.ta][0]}. Expected by about ${eta(o.ta,o.d,o.at)}.</small>${o.gift?`<small>Gift message: ${esc(o.gift)}</small>`:''}${o.code?`<small>M-Pesa code ${esc(o.code)}. We are confirming your payment.</small>`:''}
<div class="stamp">${ST[o.st][0]}</div><div class="bar"><i style="width:${Math.round((o.st+1)/ST.length*100)}%"></i></div>
<ol class="tl">${ST.map((s,i)=>{const d=i<o.st||fin;return`<li class="${d?'done':i==o.st?'now':''}"><span class="dot">${d?'✓':i+1}</span><div><b>${s[0]}</b>${ts[i]?`<small>${fmtT(ts[i])}</small>`:''}${i==o.st&&!fin?`<small style="color:var(--blue)">${s[1]}</small>`:''}</div></li>`}).join('')}</ol>
<h3>Items in this order</h3>${o.items.map(i=>`<div class="row"><div class="th sm">${svg(i)}</div><div class="grow"><b>${qtyOf(i)} × ${esc(i.n)}</b><small>${desc(i)}</small></div></div>`).join('')}
<div style="display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px"><button class="btn ghost" onclick="ro('${o.id}')">Order these again</button>${fin?'':'<button class="lnk" onclick="adv()">Staff view: move to next stage</button>'}</div></div>${ql}</div>`}};
function tots(){const s=sub(),c=(CO.cp=='FIRST10'||CO.cp=='XMAS10')?Math.round(s*.1):0,pd=CO.up?Math.min(PTS,Math.round(s*.2)):0,f=CO.d&&s-c-pd<10000?DL[CO.d][1]:0,r=TA[CO.ta][1];return{s,c,pd,f,r,t:s-c-pd+f+r}}
